note: Read-only Sync Health dashboard over Content Sync EntityStatus records. Real artifacts: routes under /admin/content/sync-health, the permission 'access sync health', and the bundled view content_sync_entity_status. Medium/hard are grounded in that permission and user roles (creatable/inspectable via drush, no sync backend needed).

evals.prompt: The cms_content_sync_health module adds a reporting dashboard. At what admin path is the Sync Health overview, and what does the dashboard report on?
evals.expected_output: The Sync Health overview is at /admin/content/sync-health (route entity.cms_content_sync.sync_health); it reports per-entity syndication status (from EntityStatus records) and flow version mismatches.

evals.prompt: Which permission does cms_content_sync_health define to control access to its Sync Health dashboard?
evals.expected_output: The permission is 'access sync health' (defined in cms_content_sync_health.permissions.yml); it gates all Sync Health routes.

evals.prompt: The Sync Health dashboard includes an 'Entity Status' tab. Which bundled Views view backs it, and which submodule does cms_content_sync_health depend on for that views integration?
evals.expected_output: The Entity Status tab is backed by the bundled view content_sync_entity_status (views.view.content_sync_entity_status). It depends on the cms_content_sync_views submodule (plus dynamic_entity_reference and views).

evals.prompt: On this site, exactly one custom user role has been granted access to the Content Sync Sync Health dashboard. Inspect the live roles/permissions and give the machine id of that role.
evals.expected_output: The role ccs_health_known has the 'access sync health' permission (check drush role:list or user.role.ccs_health_known permissions).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a user role with machine id 'ccs_health_viewer' (label 'CCS Health Viewer') and grant it the permission that lets it view the Content Sync Sync Health dashboard. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A role ccs_health_viewer exists and has the 'access sync health' permission (e.g. drush role:create ccs_health_viewer 'CCS Health Viewer'; drush role:perm:add ccs_health_viewer 'access sync health').
